subject: Who owns the root package.json / workspace?
body: D-contracts-002 makes contracts/ a standalone package @peak-state/contracts. No lane owns a root package.json, so lanes can't import it by name. Can coord own a root npm workspace (contracts, onboarding, sensing, reps, app)? Until then lanes import by relative path ../contracts/src. Also M0 report: SessionStart board printed, claim worked, edit guard blocked tools/guard-test.txt naming coord, validate passes.
